regions.name: Rio Pindaré
regions.quote: Three specimens collected in the rio Pindaré, Maranhão state, Brazil represent the only known record of a cynodontid species in northeastern Brazil.

regions.name: Rio Uatumã
regions.quote: It occurs sympatrically with the congener C. septenarius in the rio Uatumã, Brazil and the two also occur in proximity in the rio Branco and rio Trombetas systems.
